summary: This tutorial covers creating and customizing slide masters and designs in LibreOffice Impress. It starts with setting up the background for all slides using the Slide Master. Users learn to access and modify the Slide Master by clicking on the 'Master' and then 'Slide Master' options from the menu. They can also customize the background color and text formatting for all slides uniformly. The tutorial demonstrates changing the background to white and adjusting text color for better visibility. It further explains how to add shapes like rectangles, circles, and triangles to slides using the Basic Shapes toolbar. Users can create and position these shapes on the slide by clicking and dragging. The tutorial also shows how to align the edges of shapes precisely using control points. Overall, it provides a comprehensive guide to designing consistent and visually appealing presentations in LibreOffice Impress.
